recipe.visualDefinition: A layered composition featuring a large, softly blurred monochromatic background with a sharp, rectangular inset portrait in the lower right, contrasted by bold horizontal sans-serif type and vertical expressive script.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between the sharp inset photo and the hazy, atmospheric background
Juxtaposition of rigid geometric type and fluid organic handwriting
Asymmetrical balance with heavy elements on the right and vertical text on the left
Color harmony between the muted blue-grey field and the warm-toned inset portrait
coreInvariants: White border around the inset photograph
Vertical orientation for the script text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Primary subject is an inset portrait in the bottom right quadrant, occupying approximately 40% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The sharp, high-contrast inset photo acts as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bold horizontal name, move down the vertical script on the left, and settle on the inset portrait.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample negative space in the top left and center, filled with a soft, out-of-focus texture.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted slate blue-grey background with a subtle gradient.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep charcoal or black for the primary display type.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm skin tones and gold highlights within the inset photo.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation in the background allows the higher saturation and contrast of the inset photo to pop.
paletteRestrictions: Limit background to cool, desaturated tones

letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses wide, all-caps geometric forms with consistent stroke weight
Secondary text uses a continuous, loose-loop cursive script with varying pressure
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'A' in the sans-serif has a high crossbar
The script features elongated descenders and ascenders that overlap
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Structural contrast: Rigid, dark geometric sans-serif paired with fluid, white organic script.
graphicDevices: White rectangular frame for the inset photo
Subtle drop shadow on the inset frame

preserve: The vertical orientation of the script
The white border on the photo

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric, wide-set uppercase display text
Captures the loose, handwritten feel of the vertical text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a soft, out-of-focus background in muted slate blue. In the bottom right, place a sharp, high-contrast portrait of a man in a black shirt, framed by a thin white border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the primary name in a bold, dark grey geometric sans-serif across the top. Add the secondary title in a white, vertical, hand-written script along the left side.

verificationChecks: Is the script text oriented vertically?
Does the inset photo have a distinct white border?
Is the background color desaturated and cool-toned?
Is the primary name in all-caps sans-serif?

adjustableVariables: Background color hue (e.g., muted green or brown)
Thickness of the white photo border
Degree of blur in the background image
mustRedesign: Avoid using the specific artist's likeness
Do not replicate the exact signature/handwriting
postGenerationChecks: Check for visual balance between the heavy text and the inset photo
Ensure the white script is legible against the background
Verify the inset photo is sharp compared to the background
Confirm the sans-serif type is properly tracked (spaced out)
recipe.reuseFormula: Muted Background + Sharp Inset Photo + (Bold Sans-Serif + Vertical Script)
